game: The Lord of the Rings: Conquest
project: The Lord of the Rings: Conquest 360 Recompiled
approach: The 360 default.xex statically recompiled to x86-64 C++ with ReXGlue, a game-specific runtime standing in for the Xbox, drawn by the SDK's Xenos renderer on Vulkan only (no D3D12). Windows first, then native Linux and the Steam Deck.
notes: Boots on Windows through the logos and menus into the Training level, which plays with correct rendering except the screen-space distortion effects (Pandemic's Magellan engine, Havok, Scaleform, Wwise). Fixed so far: levels washed out to white (the game reads its exposure luminance back from a resolve on the CPU) and blown-out audio (a 2^x underflow in the code generator). Next: the campaign, screen-space distortion effects, then Linux. No game data included: bring your own Xbox 360 copy.
